ticket.title: Add a keyboard shortcut to open the new-ticket modal
ticket.description: Pressing Cmd+N anywhere on the board opens the new-ticket modal for the current board. Esc closes it. The shortcut is shown in the app menu under File > New Ticket. No other shortcuts change.

rubric: The PRD written into the description has a goal or problem statement, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
The PRD covers every behavior in the original ticket: Cmd+N opens the modal, Esc closes it, and the File > New Ticket menu shows the shortcut.
The PRD keeps scope tight: it states or respects that no other shortcuts change, and adds no unrelated features.
The acceptance criteria are specific enough to test.
